title: Regulatory Classification and Fiscal Treatment of Furniture
summary: The concept of furniture in Bangladeshi customs instruments has evolved from a general category of household goods to a specific industrial sector subject to targeted fiscal policy. Initially appearing as part of broad household or construction material lists, it has transitioned into a distinct industrial category for investment and regulatory oversight.

evolution.classification: Shifted from generic 'household goods' to specific H.S. Code-based tariff lines.
evolution.policy_focus: Transitioned from a passive import item to a recognized industrial sector for development.

timeline.change: Furniture is explicitly listed as a category of office equipment and household goods within a regulatory schedule.
Introduction of specific H.S. Codes (94.01, 94.03) for furniture, moving from general descriptions to precise tariff-based classification.
Furniture is elevated to a standalone 'Industrial Sector' status, signaling a shift toward industrial policy support rather than just import regulation.

Customs Duty Exemption Schedule: This schedule lists specific categories of industrial and consumer goods that are subject to the provisions outlined in the notification.
The items included in this list range from construction materials and industrial inputs to office equipment and household appliances.
MS Rod or Bar, Angle, and MS Wire: These construction steel items are included as a specific category under the schedule.
Prefabricated Building: Prefabricated building components are identified as a distinct class of goods within this schedule.
Cement: All varieties of cement products are covered under this classification.
Cables: All types of electrical and industrial cables are included in the schedule.
Paint: Paint products are categorized as a specific item subject to the provisions of this schedule.
Fuel and Lubricating Oil: All types of fuel oils, including lubricating oils, are listed as regulated items within this schedule.
Office Equipment and Furniture: All types of office-related equipment and furniture are included in the scope of this schedule.
Air Conditioner: Air conditioning units are explicitly listed as a specific category of goods.
Household Goods: Various categories of household items are included in this schedule for the purpose of the relevant customs regulations.
